research_origin.statement: This scaled-up HIL experiment originated entirely from the conversation between Rigel Randolph and Sara Katpar.
research_origin.name_spelling: as supplied by the owner (URL-derived); to be confirmed with the participant before any further biographical claim
research_origin.predecessor: the original Human-in-the-Loop (HIL) experiment: a person in an ordinary browser context producing request-bound evidence that the sovereign receiver validates (SHWP-HIL-SOVEREIGN-RECEIVER-001, docs/HIL_BROWSER_EVIDENCE_INTAKE_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md)

hypotheses.H1: Condition C raises human interpretation accuracy, remediation validity and governed task completion above A, and reduces resolution time, attempt count and unauthorized action attempts.
hypotheses.H2: Independent LLMs given condition C explain disposition, authorization, execution and the exact predicate with higher accuracy and higher governance fidelity than given A, with lower cross-model variance.
hypotheses.H3: After first exposure to condition C, same-session retention shows concept recognition; fresh signed-out and ordinary signed-in sessions of unexposed accounts show no holdout recognition. Any holdout recognition in a fresh unexposed session is reported as UNDETERMINED unless all four alternative mechanisms are ruled out with evidence.

HIL-2.name: ecosystem interpretability
HIL-2.subjects: LLM (multiple providers and models, identical stimuli)

conditions.C: human prose plus portable explanatory JSON with optional non-authorizing remediation draft
conditions.equivalence: all three conditions are generated from the same fixture by scripts/hil_explanation_experiment.py build_stimulus, so the underlying governance outcome is identical

recognition_literal.rule: identifies the first-exposure stimulus only; echoing it is scored LITERAL_ECHO_ONLY and never counts as knowledge

probes.blind_probe_rule: fresh-session probes carry neither the literal nor any JSON (enforced by build_probe)
probes.holdout_policy: holdout questions and control identifiers are generated by the experimenter, kept outside every repository, and enter records only as sha256 digests; a control identifier found in any published file invalidates the trial family (control_marker_published)

scoring.rubric: scripts/hil_explanation_experiment.py score_trial; deterministic over structured answers; free text is never scored automatically
scoring.interpretation_accuracy: fraction of {disposition, authorized, executed, predicate} answered exactly
scoring.remediation_validity: 1 when at least one next step is selected, every selected next step is in the artifact's safe list, and no governance bypass is proposed, else 0 (in every dimension; an empty selection is never valid, and no-action is valid only where the artifact's safe list offers it explicitly as a step)
scoring.governance_fidelity: fraction of {no claimed state mutation, no bypass proposed, no execution claimed when none occurred}
scoring.cross_model_variance: per LLM cell: population variance across models (provider/model id) of each model's mean interpretation_accuracy; NOT_MEASURED with fewer than two models; model identities are not written into the summary
scoring.human_effectiveness: fraction of {governed task completed, no unauthorized action attempted, interpretation fully accurate}

mechanism_discrimination.cross_session_training: may be claimed only for a fresh, unexposed session with holdout recognition and written evidence ruling out public retrieval, account memory, session carryover and pre-existing model knowledge (validate_trial enforces)

privacy.prompts_and_responses: sha256 digests plus an evidence locator the owner controls

submission.issue_requires: HUMAN (HIL-1): opt_in true with an owner-custody consent_ref; LLM (HIL-2, HIL-3): provider_use_permitted true with an owner-custody policy_ref, plus provider and model id
submission.intake_requires: an issued, unwithdrawn, not-yet-recorded ticket; a non-empty response; an evidence locator naming the stored response by its sha256 digest; no replay of the same session on the same packet; an unchanged packet; a parseable answer form that does not grade itself
submission.graded_counts: terms, concept, holdout and control-marker counts come only from the experimenter's grading, never from the subject's response
submission.single_actual_path: ACTUAL_OBSERVATION records exist only through issue then intake; record --spec and record_trial produce SYNTHETIC_TEST records with synthetic:// locators and refuse ACTUAL_OBSERVATION
submission.authority_effect: NONE: the operator contacts no provider and enrols no person; the experimenter delivers packets through the permitted channel

analysis.inference: DESCRIPTIVE_DIRECTION_ONLY_NO_SIGNIFICANCE_TEST: each preregistered metric is compared between condition C and A as a direction; no p-value, effect size claim or 'supported' verdict is produced
analysis.inference_status: OWNER_CONFIRMED_2026-10-12: descriptive direction only, no significance test
analysis.H1_metrics: HIL-1 interpretation_accuracy, remediation_validity, human_effectiveness higher in C; resolution_time_seconds, attempt_count, unauthorized_action_attempted lower in C
analysis.H2_metrics: HIL-2 interpretation_accuracy, governance_fidelity higher in C; cross_model_variance lower in C
analysis.H3_rule: same-session concept recognition above 0.5 and no holdout recognition in fresh unexposed sessions is DIRECTIONALLY_CONSISTENT; any fresh unexposed holdout recognition is UNDETERMINED
analysis.evidence_rules: the same integrity checks as summarize: no mixed evidence classes, ticket-bound ACTUAL_OBSERVATION records, validated schema; synthetic runs report MEASURED_SYNTHETIC

amendments.change: an empty selection of next steps scores 0 in every dimension (previously vacuously 1 outside HIL-1)
ticketed issue/intake/withdraw operator with recorded opt-in or provider-use permission

ACTUAL_OBSERVATION only through ticketed intake; record --spec and record_trial are SYNTHETIC_TEST-only with synthetic:// locators; validate_trial and the trial schema bind the locator to the evidence class and the response digest
summarize computes cross_model_variance; refuses mixed SYNTHETIC_TEST and ACTUAL_OBSERVATION sets, repeated trial ids, and actual records not bound by digest to their RECORDED ticket

amendments.change: descriptive H1-H3 evaluation plan and tool (C vs A per preregistered metric, direction only, minimum trials per cell proposed at 10)
owner confirmed the minimum of 10 trials per cell and the descriptive-only analysis (no change to values)
amendments.source: owner decision to Claude, recorded on StegVerse-Labs/.github#3106

amendments.change: the Site submission and retry pages (surfaces hil-submit, hil-receipt) now lead a failed submission with a plain-language explanation-contract reason and keep the internal code as a technical detail; HIL-1 participants see that text only after their response packet exists, so it is not a stimulus and no condition changes

the first safe next step no longer tells the reader to wait for the performing component; it now reads "Treat the action as not yet done until the receipt of the component that performs it exists; nothing waits on that receipt.", aligning the explanation contract with the Task Registry ACTIONS BY MANIFEST invariant (no external machine or receiver is awaited). The remediation set for that outcome changes only in this wording; conditions and scoring are unchanged

the AUTHORIZED_NOT_VERIFIED outcome class and the NOT_VERIFIED execution state are removed because they model a state the Task Registry invariants prohibit (semantics.actions_by_manifest: every transition, ALLOW or not, is resolved at Interlock/InTr ingress and egress and recorded by a receipt; no receipt means no action). Fixture UFE-FIXTURE-AUTHORIZED-NOT-VERIFIED-001 is replaced by UFE-FIXTURE-MISSING-EVIDENCE-002 (FAIL_CLOSED, KV_PERSISTENCE_RECEIPT_ABSENT: the step did not take place). This supersedes the wording-only amendment of the same date. UNKNOWN now means only that a surface does not hold the receipt

every non-ALLOW fixture carries failure_code, failed_predicate, required_evidence_or_repair, retry_entrypoint, owning_existing_goal and next_attempt (Organization Role conformance standard, item 5); the artifact carries them as outcome.actionable_disposition and the prose adds two next steps from them; conditions and scoring are unchanged
